# Cash Lever: LoC Draw vs Deferred AWS Spend

**Recommendation: Defer AWS spend for 45 days.**

Current cash position of $14.2M [^ns-cash-2026-05-27] combined with committed 90-day pipeline of $4.2M [^sf-pipeline-2026-05-27] makes a LoC draw unnecessary through W30. AWS spend of $1.8M/month [^aws-spend-2026-05-27] is deferrable within COS-confirmed operational constraints.

The Red-Team challenge on pipeline reliability (22% slip rate) does not change the recommendation — even a 35% slip leaves the trough manageable without LoC exposure.

## Action

1. Defer AWS reserved-instance renewal by 45 days (EC2/Collab exempted per COS constraint).
2. Re-validate AWS Cost Explorer data at day 30 per Red-Team concern.
3. Do not draw LoC unless pipeline slip exceeds 35%.
